question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The killing of one’s sister
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sororicide**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Sororicide"** means the act of killing one’s sister. (बहन की हत्या)

 
 
• **Example: **The crime of **sororicide** shocked the entire community.
 
 
 
• **"Sororicide" **is derived from the Latin words "soror" meaning sister and "cide" meaning killing. (बहन की हत्या)
 
 
• **Example: **He was accused of sororicide after the tragic incident.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sororicide**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Uxoricide** (पत्नी की हत्या): The act of killing one’s wife.

 
 
• **Example:** The man was charged with uxoricide after the investigation.
 
 
 
• **Parricide** (माता-पिता की हत्या): The act of killing one’s parents.
 
 
• **Example: **The heinous act of parricide left the family in ruins.
 
 
 
• **Regicide** (राजा की हत्या): The act of killing a king.
 
 
• **Example:** The plot to commit regicide was uncovered just in time.
